CREATE MASTER KEY ENCRYPTION BY PASSWORD = 'pass@123';

--CREATE CREADIANCIAL
CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL SynapseCreds
WITH
     IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity';
    

    --EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE
    CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE raw_Ext_source
    WITH
    (
        LOCATION = 'https://azuresynapse05.blob.core.windows.net/raw',
        CREDENTIAL = SynapseCreds
    );

--https://azuresynapse05.blob.core.windows.net/raw/reveune/Brokennames.csv

SELECT * FROM 
OPENROWSET
(
    BULK 'reveune/Brokennames.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_Ext_source',
    FORMAT='CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = FALSE
) AS QUERY1;
